data.why: The repo ships a synthetic 1000-gene x 10-sample Cancer-vs-Normal count matrix and matching metadata with seeded BRCA1 up/TP53 down hits, usable both via the built-in demo button and as upload test files.

goals: Load a count matrix and sample metadata and confirm they align (sample IDs match, groups are readable)
Run PyDESeq2 differential expression between a chosen contrast group and reference group
Identify which genes are significantly up- or down-regulated under adjustable log2FC and padj thresholds
Explore the volcano plot interactively to spot and hover over top hits
Export the full results table (fold changes, p-values) for downstream use

review.summary: This tree describes the tool accurately: load counts and metadata, run a PyDESeq2 contrast, set the cutoffs live, explore the volcano, and export. Its labels are faithful and every screen I opened shows what its node claims. Before filing, it needs the non-scientific, crash-prone language phase dropped, the t1/t2 branch tags fixed, and the duplicate t6 run removed.
